summary: Scroll restore fix VERIFIED on both desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). Forward nav lands at top, Back restores the exact previous scroll position instantly and holds it, forward-after-back also lands at top.

desktop_1920x800.back_samples_100ms_3s: all 30 samples = 1800 (restored on first sample, held stable)

mobile_390x844.back_samples_100ms_3s: all 30 samples = 5000 (restored on first sample, held stable)

test_details.notes: document.body (id=kt_app_body) confirmed as true scroll container (body.scrollHeight 2703 desktop / 9661 mobile; documentElement.scrollHeight equals viewport). Prior clamp-to-148/198 bug from iteration_4 no longer reproduces — suppressSave on router.on('before') prevents the clamp value from being recorded.

test_credentials: buyer@test.com / password (not needed — public homepage tested)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scroll restore is working correctly on both viewports. body.scrollTop is the source of truth (id=kt_app_body). MAX==FINAL==pre-nav on both viewports means restore is immediate and stable (no bounce back to clamp).
rca of the issue: Previous iteration_4 failure RCA (already fixed by main agent): during Inertia DOM swap, new short page temporarily clamped body.scrollTop to ~148/198 and the scroll listener wrongly persisted that clamp as the leaving page's saved position. Fix (in /app/laravel_project/project/resources/js/app.js) sets suppressSave=true immediately on router.on('before')/popstate so the clamp is not recorded, and restoreScroll re-applies the saved target for up to 2s. Verified working.
